description: For distinct incomparable points of an irreflexive transitive relation, the displayed adjoined-comparison relation is irreflexive and transitive, extends the original relation, and adds the new pair.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.adjoinComparison_spec.{u} {α : Type u} (r : α → α → Prop) (hirr : Std.Irrefl r)
  (htrans : IsTrans α r) (a b : α) (hne : a ≠ b) (hab : ¬r a b) (hba : ¬r b a) :
  Std.Irrefl (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.adjoinComparison r a b) ∧
    IsTrans α (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.adjoinComparison r a b) ∧
      (∀ (x y : α), r x y → Lemmatheca.SetTheory.adjoinComparison r a b x y) ∧
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.adjoinComparison r a b a b ∧ ¬r a b
